text:
Priya Nair: heads up — billing-bot just flagged 3 consecutive card declines for ACME Corp (acct ending 2241). invoices  INV-20247, INV-20248, INV-20249 all failed this morning.
Matt Gomez: ugh. any AVS or fraud flags?
billing-bot: Automated alert: payment_method=card_last4=2241 status=declined code=do_not_honor attempts=3
Olivia Chan: I can ping CS to ask for alternate payment method and wire instructions. do we want to try a last automated retry?
Priya Nair: yes — do one scheduled retry now (immediate), then stop automated retries and switch to manual plan if it fails. hold off on dunning emails for 24h while CS reaches out.
Evan Li: logging the action: retry_ticket=FT-1129 action=auto_retry timestamp=1772004330
Tasha Rivera: I messaged the ACME PO asking for updated payment method and wire details. suggested two options: retry with new card or send wire. asked for ETA.
Priya Nair: thanks Tasha. if they choose wire we need the wire instructions template — Olivia can you paste our standard minimal wire template here so I can send?
Olivia Chan: sure — here's our minimal template to request from customer:
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Bank: First Partner Bank
Routing (ABA/SWIFT): [please provide]  <-- we ask customer to confirm
Account number: [redacted - we will provide on secure channel]
Reference: customer_name + invoice numbers
Amount: USD XXXX
```
Note: we never include full account numbers in Slack. request = please confirm bank name, SWIFT/ABA, and beneficiary reference.
Matt Gomez: also request a remittance email with invoice numbers and amounts so we can reconcile immediately.
Priya Nair: agreed. once they confirm wire, schedule manual reconciliation and mark invoices as pending-wire. create a temporary hold on service only if balance > $100k (ACME is ~45k, so no hold).
Tasha Rivera: ACME replied: "we had a card limit hit; we'll initiate wire today, expected settlement 48-72 hours. wire details attached (pdf)."
Evan Li: ok — can somebody upload the remittance to the billing ticket and set status=pending_wire?
Olivia Chan: done. uploaded pdf to FT-1129 and added note: "expected settlement 48-72h per acme email".
Priya Nair: I'll create the payment retry policy for manual follow-up: Day0 auto retry attempted; Day1 contact + hold dunning; Day2 check settlement; Day4 escalate to AR if no settle.
Matt Gomez: add a fallback: if wire fails, ask for ACH setup — include ACH setup link + instructions.
Olivia Chan: adding ACH option to template: "If wire isn't possible, please complete ACH authorization here: https://billing.redwood.ai/ach-setup"
Priya Nair: perfect. Tasha — once they confirm the wire completion, send the remittance screenshot to finance and update ticket. I'll mark invoices INV-20247/8/9 as pending until funds clear.
Tasha Rivera: will do.
Priya Nair: closing loop: automated retry ran at 1772004330 and failed. manual plan in place. next check-in 1772008060 (~10h). tnks all :thumbsup:
Matt Gomez: thanks — keep me posted, I want to ensure no SLA churn risk.
billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: check_ticket=FT-1129 remind_at=1772008060
Olivia Chan: noted. added internal note for bookkeeping: tag=wire_expected tag=acme
Priya Nair: end of thread — documented in FT-1129 and AR queue will monitor if no settlement by Day4.
